li.label: Thunderborn Mentality
li.description: The rage is gone. The glory days remain.

li.label: Thunderborn Mentality
li.description: Things still feel... off. Quieter, but off.

li.label: Thunderborn Mentality

li.label: Thunderborn Mentality

li.label: Thunderborn Mentality
li.description: The fury was cut out. What it carved is still in here.
